description:
validate_ascii_label at pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:601 accepts underscore. The inline comment at lines 602-606 justifies this as 'widely tolerated' and 'symmetry'.

The module-level rustdoc on ServerName::dns_name (lines 165-168) advertises 'LDH (letter / digit / hyphen) rule of RFC 1035 §2.3.1'. RFC 1035 LDH does NOT include underscore. A reader of the public doc would not expect 'host_name.example' to be accepted.

Either:
- Tighten the validator to strict LDH (reject _), and document that some legacy SANs with underscores cannot be matched as targets.
- Update the rustdoc to say 'LDH plus underscore, matching common SAN-in-the-wild tolerance'. Both choices are valid; the doc and code should agree publicly.

Currently the doc says strict-LDH and the code is permissive. A user submitting a bug report 'why does dns_name accept host_name.example' will get pointed at the lines 602-606 comment they can't see from rustdoc.
title: Underscore in DNS labels accepted with comment, but inconsistent with strict-LDH framing in module doc
